previous_text_retained.sample_rule: Complete hourly Hyperliquid funding observations paired with same-UTC-hour Binance public data; entry immediately after observed funding event, exact one-hour hold, exit at next complete hourly observation.
previous_text_retained.state: Signed Hyperliquid fundingRate plus HL BTC mid / Binance BTCUSDT mark - 1, requiring timestamps within 5 seconds and passing source completeness predicates.
previous_text_retained.cost_floor: Optimistic structural Hyperliquid base-tier taker fee floor: 0.045% per side; Binance fee, funding, spread, impact, borrow, capital, margin, transfer, liquidation and account terms remain UNKNOWN and are not imputed.
previous_text_retained.primary_metric: Paired one-hour gross carry plus mark-to-market hedge residual before unknown Binance costs; descriptive only, not net return.
previous_text_retained.result: No pilot run; strict no-purchase check observed one of two expected Hyperliquid hourly buckets and Binance public endpoints returned HTTP 451 in this environment.

what_changed: Price term: causal LAST-TRADE closes of COMPLETED hourly candles on both legs, labelled REFERENCE prices. The Binance mark series is excluded from the price term; at most a candle that closed at or before the decision instant may be used.
Boundary staleness is measured and reported for both legs against a tolerance declared before the run (1.0 s).
The gross is SIGNED (funding carry of both legs plus the hedge mark-to-market residual), in bps of notional, sign-corrected for the short-HL/long-Binance structure.

Cost treatment: only the LOWEST VERIFIED UNAVOIDABLE floor justified by the frozen implementation may enter C0; the published volume/staking/account-state dependent tiers are a REFERENCE EXECUTION PATH scenario and their unresolved component stays in C1. Unknown is never zero.
Inference: hour-clustered percentile bootstrap with a fixed declared seed; significance reported separately and never an input to the classification.
what_is_unchanged: the pair (SHORT Hyperliquid Core BTC perp, LONG equal-notional Binance USD(S)-M BTCUSDT perp)
the direction and the exact one-hour hold
the pairing rule (floor timestamps to the exact UTC hour, exact 1:1 matching, 100% coverage of the availability-derived window, zero missing, zero duplicates, no post-outcome window shrinking)
no pair substitution, no oracle substitution, no model fitting, no horizon change, no fee imputation

instrument_pair.leg_a: Short 1 unit Hyperliquid Core BTC linear perpetual (BTC, first perp dex, USDC collateral).
instrument_pair.leg_b: Long equal-BTC-notional Binance USD(S)-M BTCUSDT perpetual.
instrument_pair.reverse_direction: Sign flip only; not a second tested strategy.
instrument_pair.direction: UNCONDITIONAL short-A / long-B, entered every admitted hour; no sign conditioning and no state filter.

sample_rule: The admitted 4,981-hour panel (2026-03-05T11:00:00Z to 2026-09-28T23:00:00Z, 100% paired hourly buckets). Decision at hour J immediately after the observed Hyperliquid funding settlement of bucket J, entered on the last completed reference candle (row J-1, covering [J-1h, J)), held exactly one hour, exited at the next complete hourly observation (row J, covering [J, J+1h)). The carry collected over the hold is the settlement labelled J+1 on each venue (Hyperliquid pays the hour that has elapsed; Binance settles 8-hourly). 4,979 holds, contiguous, zero missing, zero duplicates.
state: Signed Hyperliquid fundingRate at the decision instant plus the reference-price basis HL close / Binance kline close - 1 measured on completed candles. Reported descriptively; it does not gate the unconditional decision rule.

reference_prices.hyperliquid: hl_mid_1h_close - Hyperliquid candleSnapshot 1h close, trade-derived, REFERENCE price (not a mid, not executable)
reference_prices.binance: binance_kline_close - Binance USD(S)-M klines 1h close (last trade), REFERENCE price (not executable)
reference_prices.excluded: binance_mark_close - marks are not last trades and are not executable; excluded from the price term, retained in the manifest for provenance

cost_floor: C0 = the LOWEST rung of the published Hyperliquid perp taker schedule, 0.024% per side, applied to open+close on the Hyperliquid leg = 4.8 bps of notional per one-hour hold (SRC-0213, accessed 2026-09-20). C1 = the state-dependent uplift to the 0.045% base tier (4.2 bps/hold), the Binance taker fee (UNKNOWN), spread/impact/slippage (UNKNOWN), and capital/margin/borrow/transfer/liquidation terms (UNKNOWN). No unknown is imputed as zero.
primary_metric: Signed strategy gross P&L per one-hour hold in bps of notional: funding carry of both legs plus the hedge mark-to-market residual, sign-corrected for the short-HL/long-Binance structure. T* = C0 / (carry per hour) is reported as an interpretive quantity only.
inference: Hour-clustered percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 20260930, 2.5/97.5 percentiles; moving-block (24 h) variant reported as a serial-dependence check. Significance is reported separately and is never the decision criterion.
kill_rule: Shared contract, imported from M2/src/envelope.py::classify_materiality: KILL_MATERIALITY if g <= 0 or the uncertainty upper bound hi <= C0; SURVIVE_PROVISIONAL if the lower bound lo > C0; otherwise INDETERMINATE with the clause named. A coverage-floor failure is INDETERMINATE_COVERAGE, named, never a silent re-scope. A kill is scoped to this frozen one-hour formulation; a longer-horizon reformulation would be a NEW candidate, not a reinterpretation.
continuation_rule: Only a SURVIVE_PROVISIONAL outcome on verified all-leg cost schedules would justify an execution-model pass; the base-tier reference path may not decide a kill on its own.
result: Recorded in M2/experiments/M2-BRIDGE-HL-BINANCE-BASIS/results.json (this specification is the contract and is not rewritten by the outcome).
previous_result: No pilot run in the pre-C5 state; strict no-purchase check observed one of two expected Hyperliquid hourly buckets and Binance public endpoints returned HTTP 451 in that environment.
